newsitem.title: CANADA: Future Shop expects profitable second half.
newsitem.headline: Future Shop expects profitable second half.

text.p: Electronics retailer Future Shop Ltd said Tuesday it expects to report a profit for the second half of its fiscal year ending next March.

Chief financial officer Gary Patterson said the company "absolutely" anticipates a profit in the next two quarters but declined to predict a specific level. "Christmas is coming and no one can predict Christmas," he said.
The company, which had a profit of C$1.1 million in its second quarter to September 30 but a loss of $5.3 million for the six months, said it has taken measures to improve profitability.
Sales were weak in the second quarter due to poor industry performance, continued lackluster consumer spending and competitive markets, the company said.
"As we enter the third quarter we are looking forward to the critical Christmas season. We are in a very good position to participate strongly in any improvement in industry sales," Future Shop said.
